messages.subject: No imputation
parts:
Dear MSstats Team:

I used "quant <- dataProcess(msstats.raw, fillIncompleteRows=TRUE, normalization="quantile") for model based inputation".  But in my export table. I didn't see any value has been imputed. Wondering the is there anything wrong with the code? I found this code from (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/msstats/imputation%7Csort:relevance/msstats/QzNVnF2ASXc/zvGKCMjNCAAJ) . Also, what does the normalization = "quantile" mean?

Thanks a lot for your help.
Cheers
Cheng

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: No imputation
parts:
Dear Cheng,

quant$ProcessedData : reeformatted and normalized data. It does not include imputed values.
quant$RunlevelData : summarized values after imputation.

Please check the manual, (msstats.org > workflow > user manual for MSstats) for normalization options. and other documentations are also available in msstats.org.

Hope to help.

Sincerely,
- Meena
